::: {.section-card}
#### Green skills intensity by sector

Green skill mentions are not evenly distributed across the economy. The **highest within-section green shares** appear in **utilities (E)**, **energy (D)**, **agriculture (A)** and **public administration (P)** — sectors where environmental regulation and sustainability reporting are most salient. In absolute terms, green demand is still largest in **trade (G)**, **professional services (N)** and **manufacturing (C)** because those sections dominate total posting volume.
